content.text: {"quote_faithful": "yes", "verdict": "confirmed", "evidence_kind": "missing_justification", "fatal": "yes", "explanation": "The quote appears verbatim in Case k\u22651, subcase \u03bc>\u03c4, the main branch of the lower-bound induction. Two defects are real. (i) D_rest is never defined: the text only introduces \"R' is R optionally enlarged by a virtual complementary piece\", with a parenthetical assertion, and then silently substitutes D_rest. (ii) The needed bound D_rest \u2264 \u03bc-1 is not proved; the accompanying clause (\"the identity D_rest=\u03bc-1 in the worst case ... which is compatible with \u22651\") is circular/garbled, not an argument. Moreover the padding step is inconsistent and unjustified: d is defined both as S_{n-1}-(S_n-\u03bc)=\u03bc-2^n and as \u03bc-\u03c4=\u03bc-2^{n-1}, and P\u222aR plus an arbitrary dummy need not be a refinement of the bins B_{n-1} required by the induction hypothesis. Nothing elsewhere repairs this: the text falls back on \"numerical checks for n\u22643\". Hence obligation (L) fails for general n."}
